Channing Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Channing Capital Management Llc sold 7,443 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 49,198 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.33 million, down from 56,641 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Channing Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $833.25 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.57 $164.22. About 24.34M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
